sam: FYI: 'delta-split' pricing experiment launches tomorrow 07:00 PT for 3% of accounts. Need final preflight and special-case handling for split invoices (multi-subscriber accounts). @rita @jon_fin can you confirm invoice stitching rules?

rita: Confirming. Stitching rule: merge lineitems by invoice_id then apply cohort tag 'delta_split'. For accounts with multiple subs, allocate delta pro-rata by seat_count. Adding validation for negative lineitems after allocation.

jon_fin: Running preflight now. Will flag any negative deltas and produce preflight_split.csv. Please confirm auto-credit threshold: auto-credit up to $300, review >$300?

vineet: Ops: agree with $300 auto-credit. Also add a guard: if >1% of cohort has negative final amounts, auto-pause cohort.

ops-bot: billing-preview job queued (id=33555). Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/33555

rita: Edge-case: vendor passthrough for GPU minutes needs to be split by child-subscriptions too. Mapping updated: vendor_gpu_min -> vendor_gpu_min_child. Tests running.

legal-bot: Legal approved invoice language: "Your invoice includes a temporary pricing adjustment for participating accounts. See billing help for details."

jon_fin: preflight uploaded: https://files.redwood/preflight/33555/preflight_split.csv. Summary: avg delta +0.4%, 8 accounts with negative deltas fixed by auto-credit, 1 account flagged > $300 for manual review, no vendor mismatches in sample.

sam: Great. Final checklist: stitching rule in place \u2714, vendor split mapping \u2714, preflight posted \u2714, legal text ok \u2714. Launch 07:00 PT. If pause alert fires, we'll rollback to rp_stable and rerun preview.
